Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

title: Charity admin modernisation
client: Oakfield Charities
client_industry: nonprofit
start: 2022-10
end: 2023-01
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Django

- HTMX
- Celery

built: Upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation
  entry screens with HTMX.
metrics:

The review is from: Oakfield Charities
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

text: Tobias did a great job modernising our charity admin system. He upgraded our donor platform from Django 1.11 to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX, which made a real difference for our team. Donation entry time is now down 45%, and we had zero data loss across 180k donor records. He was straightforward to work with and got the job done.
